# Add hello.txt

Create [hello.txt](hello.txt) in the workspace root with exactly this content:

```
hi
```

No other files change. `hello.txt` is not present in the current workspace listing (`README.md`, `capture`, `deny-me.txt`, `notes.txt`, `requirements`).
